{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"A tailored wool-blend blazer in a deep charcoal tone (#3a3e45), structured with slightly padded shoulders for a polished silhouette.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in matching dark denim wash (#2b2f38), cut to drape elegantly without clinging.
Cream silk blouse with a relaxed fit and delicate collar, featuring subtle gathering at the waist.
Gold-tone minimalist pendant necklace layered over the blouse neckline.
Rectangular-frame glasses with tortoiseshell acetate frames (#4a3c30) to complement her warm undertones.
Round-arch ankle boots in polished brown leather (#8b6950) for comfort during the long queue and public transport commute.

This outfit works because it balances the "smart" dress code required for a book launch with the practical needs of a cold environment and active movement. The tailored blazer and high-waisted trousers create vertical lines that visually elongate her frame, satisfying her wish to look taller while providing warmth against the chill inside the historic library. The neutral palette in deep charcoal, cream, and warm brown tones ensures she remains recognizable on camera during the photoshoot without distracting from the book or the setting."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":1170,"output_tokens":248},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
